subject: Handoff: model shortlist & token sizing for InsightsLab onboarding
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@insightslab.io>, Leah Morgan <leah@insightslab.io>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff: model shortlist & token sizing for InsightsLab onboarding

Hi Samir / Leah —

Great to meet yesterday. This thread is the handoff record from CS to Implementation for InsightsLab's pilot. I pulled together a short model shortlist and an initial token/throughput scoping based on what you shared. Please review and attach a 24–72h sample of production traffic if available (anonymized is fine).

What we need from you to finalize sizing:
- 24–72h request logs or a representative sample (path, prompt length, response length)
- Top 6 intents and expected % distribution (approx)
- Examples of the longest single-context use (documents or conversation windows) and whether retrieval augmentation will pass full docs in-context or by summary pointers

Redwood preliminary shortlist (intent -> recommended model variants):
- Intent: Short classification / lightweight summarization -> Redwood-v2-base-8k (FP16 or q4)
- Intent: High-quality summarization & multi-turn dialog -> Redwood-v2-medium-16k (FP16)
- Intent: Retrieval-augmented long context (documents >8k tokens) -> Redwood-v2-extended-32k (prefer q8_0 for cost)

Sizing notes (rough initial):
- Baseline average prompt size: 350 tokens (we'll verify)
- Baseline average completion size: 150 tokens
- Estimated daily tokens (initial pilot, 30-day ramp): ~1.2M tokens/day
- Peak concurrency observed in similar pilots: 45–120 concurrent requests; target capacity planning for your peak of ~100 concurrent bursts
- Cache opportunity: prefix & KV caching expected to reduce token consumption by ~20–35% for multi-turn flows

Suggested implementation footprint (pilot):
- Hosted/Dedicated recommendation: start on Dedicated (reserved pool) with 2x A100-equivalent GPUs for Redwood-v2-medium profile and fallback routing to base-8k for non-critical paths. Add a 3rd GPU for the retrieval-extended variant if retrieval throughput >150 docs/s.
- Latency goal: p95 < 700ms for base-8k, <1.2s for medium-16k under expected batching

Action items from InsightsLab:
1) Attach logs sample (insightslab_tokens_sample.csv works).
2) Confirm top intents and any SLA constraints per intent.
3) Share any internal redlines for data retention / region.

I've attached: example_prompts.jsonl (sample prompt set template) — please append a sample of your traffic into the CSV and reply. I'll loop in Ben (implementation lead) and Grace (ops) next.

Thanks —
Soojin

Subject: Fwd: Handoff: model shortlist & token sizing for InsightsLab onboarding — analysis + recommended plan

Team — forwarding InsightsLab sample. Key signals from the sample and Samir's note:
- 48h sample attached: 60% retrieval-augmented search-assist; 30% interactive chat; 10% small classification.
- Longest single-context examples ~12–18k tokens (they currently concatenate top K passages).
- Average prompt/response from sample: prompt ~420 toks, completion ~180 toks (higher than my estimate).

My read / recommended approach for pilot (conservative cost + quality):
1) Model mapping by route:
   - Search-assist (high throughput, lower token fidelity): Redwood-v2-base-8k, q4_0 quant for cost. Use prefix/response caching for repeated requests.
   - Chat flows (higher quality, multi-turn): Redwood-v2-medium-16k FP16 with KV caching enabled.
   - Doc-synthesis (12–18k in-context): Redwood-v2-extended-32k with q8_0 quant, but only route heavy syntheses to these hosts; use chunking + retrieval compression to reduce full in-context tokens where possible.

2) Token estimates (pilot projected daily):
   - Based on sample avg sizes and expected production multiplier (x2 day-of-week peak): ~2.6M tokens/day
   - Peak burst estimate: ~140 concurrent requests during morning wave; average concurrency ~50
   - Savings: expect 25–30% reduction once prefix caching and batching are enabled — adjust capacity after 2 weeks of telemetry

3) Serving footprint recommendation (pilot, 4-week):
   - Dedicated pool: 3x A100-equivalent GPUs (2 for medium / base split, 1 for extended-32k) with autoscale to add 1 more GPU on sustained CPU/GPU utilization >70%
   - Batching policy: target dynamic batching with max latency budget 800ms for base-8k paths, 1.5s for medium/16k
   - Fallback routing: when extended-32k is saturated, automatically degrade to chunked-synthesis pipeline + queue-based background job (deliver-asynchronous result) to preserve SLAs for other routes

4) Rollout & validation plan:
   - Step 0: Redwood engineering sets up dedicated pool and test harness with their sample (Ben leads)
   - Step 1: Run smoke tests and a 24h soak with synthetic peak (1.5x sample) to validate latency and token accounting
   - Step 2: Canary to 5% production traffic for 48h, monitor token burn, p95 latency, error rate, and quality regressions on a small eval set (we will run a prompt-eval suite)
   - Step 3: Full ramp to 100% with scheduled check-ins (daily for week 1)

Open items for Ben/Grace:
- Ben: estimate GPU SKU-equivalents for our pool (A100 vs H100 tradeoffs) and projected monthly cost for pilot at 2.6M tokens/day baseline vs after 30% cache savings
- Grace: confirm logging requirements (retention, redaction) and routing for EU users if any show up in traffic

I'll attach a first-draft sizing PDF. If you agree I'll mark this as the onboarding charter and send a final Plan-of-Record to InsightsLab.

Thanks —
Soojin

Thanks team — quick confirmation and next steps from implementation side. I reviewed the sample and Soojin's recommendations and agree with the three-tier model mapping. A few concrete numbers from infra side: 

- GPU SKUs: recommend H100-small equivalent for the medium-16k hosts (higher perf for multi-turn KV), and A100-equivalent for base-8k and extended-32k (cost-effective, supports q8/q4). For pilot we price on A100-equivalent and show H100 uplift as optional.
- Pilot capacity projection (monthlyized cost estimate):
   * Baseline 2.6M tokens/day -> ~78M tokens/month -> estimated inference cost $5,400/month (platform compute + token amortized)
   * With expected 30% cache reduction -> 54.6M tokens/month -> estimated $3,900/month

- Implementation checklist (deliverables):
   1) Redwood infra: provision dedicated GPU pool and test endpoints (Ben)
   2) InsightsLab: confirm intent routing endpoints and provide webhook auth (Samir)
   3) Redwood CS: prepare eval prompt set and quality checks (Soojin)
   4) Ops: logging/redaction policy and SSO test (Grace)

Samir / Leah: if that cost/footprint looks reasonable please reply with approval and we'll schedule the smoke test next Tuesday (4/28). I can share the onboarding_sizing_plan_v1.pdf after internal sign-off.

Ben Carter
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
